title: A Inheritance for the Portrait
author: Sable Blackwood
blurb: Ada Nystrom, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
